name: zen-lsp
description: Zen language support: launches `zen lsp` and speaks LSP to it.

zen.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the Zen compiler binary, which `make build` writes to the root of the checkout. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder. **This path resolves on the machine the extension host runs on** — over a remote connection that is the remote host, which is where the source and the compiler are.

zen.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the server binary. The server speaks JSON-RPC over its own stdin and stdout, so `lsp` is the whole of it. Note that `vscode-languageclient` appends `--stdio` of its own accord and `zen lsp` reads that as an absent argument. If the launch shape changes, this is the one setting to change.

zen.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the Zen output channel. Set to 'verbose' when the server will not start.
